items.difficulty_reason: 6 行、不变子模商的整扩张：I^G = R^G ∩ I 给出单射性；pol-lifting 引理验证 universally-bijective 代数引理的假设，应用后得整性、谱同胚与剩余域纯不可分扩张。承重（假设验证、结论转移）在 span 内；2 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-invariants-modulo (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 32552-32559

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: injectivity of R^G/I^G into (R/I)^G is immediate from I^G = R^G intersect I, and the polynomial lifting lemma verifies the hypothesis of the universally bijective algebra lemma which then gives integrality, the spectrum homeomorphism and purely inseparable residue field extensions (source lines 32561-32566)
